name: Assets & Maintenance workspace registry, state machine, maintenance lifecycle, and relocation

planSteps.description: Navigate to /assets on the PolarOps frontend
Verify Assets workspace header 'Assets & Equipment - Polar field gear, critical infrastructure, maintenance lifecycle, and relocation' is visible
Verify search input, asset type dropdown, and status filter selectors are present
Verify asset registry table renders asset codes, serial numbers, types, statuses, conditions, and locations
Click on an asset code chip or inspect button to open the AssetDetailPanel drawer
Verify drawer displays specifications, current location, condition, and state transition actions
Verify terminal RETIRED state behavior disables further mutations and displays terminal notice
Click 'Schedule Maintenance' button to open scheduling workflow
Verify maintenance modal captures priority, scheduled date, technician, description, and validates required fields
Click 'Start' or 'Complete' on a maintenance record
Verify completion workflow captures findings, corrective actions, and target asset status
Select destination location and execute asset relocation workflow
Verify confirmation dialog warns of consequential move before executing relocation
Verify operational timeline displays chronological events, actor context, and data provenance
